text:
incident-bot: ALERT: geo-dns-resolver-monitor reports spike in SERVFAIL/TIMEOUTs for eu-west region resolvers (external provider: Cloudflare). Affected ~10-15% of EU edge lookups. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/geodns-failover :rotating_light:

alice_ops: Yep, dashboards show a jump at ~3577769950. Customer errors and increased latency for some endpoints.

ben_network: pulling probe matrix now. Initial look: Cloudflareeu-west anycast cluster returning SERVFAIL intermittently. Route53 answers normal.

carly_oncall: I'm oncall and taking this. Priorities: 1) limit customer impact, 2) collect artifacts, 3) engage provider. Who's owning comms?

maria_support: I'll own customer notifications. Drafting short status copy.

ben_network: quick diagnostic: `curl -s https://geodns.redwood.internal/api/v2/regions/eu-west/state` -> shows per-probe fail pct: NL probes=18%, DE probes=12%, IE probes=4%. Weighted avg ~13%. Our failover threshold is 20% so auto-failover didn't kick.

frank_infra: Is there any chance the probes are siloed? We saw probe variance last month where a small subset skewed the global metric.

ben_network: good point. Some probes behind certain upstreams see higher failure rates. That caused decoupled measurements. I'm going to temporarily force an override to promote route53 as primary for eu-west while we investigate.

incident-bot: CONFIG_ACTION: geo-dns override applied by ben_network at 3577770080: region=eu-west, override_mode=force_fallback_to_route53, ttl=600.

carly_oncall: Apply and monitor. Dinesh, any caching changes we can do to reduce bounce?

dinesh_sre: I'll increase negative-cache TTL on edge resolvers for failing answers to 45s and enable sticky-resolve for 5m to keep clients hitting working backends. Rolling to EU edges now (3/3).

ben_network: Pushed override via `POST /api/v2/policies/override` with body:
```
{
  "region":"eu-west",
  "mode":"force_fallback",
  "duration_sec":600,
  "reason":"external resolver partial outage"
}
```

alice_ops: Noted. Customer impact should drop as Route53 answers increase.

eve_prod: tracing shows client-side retries still happening but successful after the override. Sample trace: `lookup id=xyz status=OK backend=route53 latency=120ms`.

maria_support: Status update draft: "Partial DNS resolution issues in EU affecting a segment of customers. Temporary routing adjustments applied to improve reliability. We'll update once upstream provider reports resolution. No data loss." OK to post?

carly_oncall: Post it, include guidance to retry and mention ticket with provider.

ben_network: opened support ticket with Cloudflare: CF-998001. Provided probe logs, timestamps, and AS paths for affected probes. They replied acknowledging and asked for BGP/peering traces.

incident-bot: TICKET_OPENED: Cloudflare CF-998001 by ben_network at 3577770145.

alice_ops: dig from our NL probe: ```;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: SERVFAIL, id: 40021
;; flags: qr rd ra; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 0```. Happening intermittently.

frank_infra: I checked upstream NAT/load balancer metrics, nothing abnormal on our side. No spikes in egress errors.

ben_network: Cloudflare responded: "observed increased error rates for a subset of resolver nodes in our eu-west anycast block; engineering deploying targeted fix to affected POPs." They asked for a hold on force-rollback until their fix propagates.

carly_oncall: How's the mitigation holding? Error rates now?

ben_network: After override and cache changes, per-probe fail pct dropped to ~2-4% across EU. Edge error count declined by ~80% in last 5m.

dinesh_sre: alert thresholds set: fire if >5% resolv error sustained for 3m. Verbose logs enabled for 20m.

maria_support: Status posted: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/3577770000. I've flagged customers with high error volumes and prepped scripts our support folks can run (dig at specific resolvers, collect trace).

eve_prod: attaching two representative traces to the incident doc: trace-eu-01, trace-eu-02. Shows initial SERVFAIL then later OK after route53.

ben_network: Cloudflare updated ticket: partial remediation deployed, full stabilization across their eu-west POPs expected in ~30 minutes.

carly_oncall: Good. Keep override in place for 30 minutes, then re-evaluate. Ben, plan for rollback steps?

ben_network: Rollback plan: 1) monitor probe health for consecutive 10m window <3% fail, 2) remove override via API, 3) revert negative-cache TTL to baseline, 4) watch for re-introduction of errors. I'll automate a canary re-enable to switch small portion (10%) back to CF first.

incident-bot: ONCALL_HANDOFF_REMINDER: carly_oncall scheduled handoff at 3577770365. Please update incident notes before handoff.

carly_oncall: Handoff notes:
- Root cause: external provider (Cloudflare) had partial failures in eu-west anycast nodes impacting DNS answers.
- Mitigations applied: forced fallback to Route53 for eu-west, increased negative-cache TTL to 45s, enabled sticky-resolve, posted status page update, opened CF ticket CF-998001.
- Next actions: monitor CF ticket for RCA, evaluate restoring CF as primary gradually after 2x10m healthy windows, prepare postmortem focusing on probe sensitivity and override runbook clarity.

maria_support: I'll continue to triage customer reports and escalate any production-impacting cases.

ben_network: Cloudflare: "full propagation of fix at edge completed" message received. I'll begin canary: enable CF for 10% of eu-west queries and watch for errors for 10 minutes.

alice_ops: observing canary window now.

ben_network: canary looks clean: error rates ~1% and not increasing. Initiating progressive rollback to revert override, target 50% in 10m then full in 20m if stable.

incident-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE: geo-dns override removed by ben_network at 3577770328; rolling reweight to prefer cloudflare gradually.

dinesh_sre: reverting negative-cache TTL to standard 5s in progress.

carly_oncall: leaving final note: incident de-escalated, temporary measures removed, monitoring for 60 more minutes. Please attach CF final update and link to postmortem when available.

incident-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: system metrics back to baseline at 3577770362. Continue watch.

frank_infra: I'll add a short blameless postmortem ticket with timeline and remediation items (probe threshold tuning, override automation tests).

-- end of thread --
